Lejre is a Danish municipality mentioned in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. The report documents clinical quality in atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities using data from the Danish National Patient Register (LPR) and the Danish Stroke Database (DanStroke) [^src1]. 

Lejre appears specifically in the data for Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulant (AC) treatment [^src1]. Its inclusion on page 94 provides a statistical snapshot of local healthcare performance, serving as a tool for benchmarking and local quality development within the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. Beyond this single tabular mention detailing its patient cohort and indicator results, no further narrative or administrative details about Lejre are available in the provided text.
